overview: The Council authorized a feasibility study for restructuring the municipal sign department and rescinded a previous funding appropriation for the City Hall roof project. Members also deliberated on proposed amendments to the City Council Rules of Order, requesting greater transparency and documentation to address concerns regarding public participation.

items.title: Sign Department Division Feasibility
items.summary: Approved a resolution to examine the feasibility of establishing the sign and striping shop as a standalone division within the Department of Public Works to improve roadway safety and maintenance.

items.title: Hall of Fame Congratulatory Resolution
items.summary: Passed a resolution congratulating the 2016 inductees into the Medford High School Mustang Hall of Fame.

items.title: Common Victualler License: RMG Donuts
items.summary: Granted a license for a Dunkin' Donuts inside the Middlesex Avenue BJ's Wholesale Club with a requested condition that the property owner address trash debris on the site.

items.title: City Hall Roof Funding Rescission
items.summary: Rescinded a $1.2 million free cash appropriation for City Hall roof and dome repairs as the project is now funded through a previously approved loan order.

items.title: Proposed Council Rules of Order Revisions
items.summary: Requested a document highlighting all proposed amendments to the Council Rules of Order following an extended debate over potential restrictions on speaking time, application requirements, and public access to televised portions of meetings.

items.title: Bus Stop, Lighting, and Road Safety Requests
items.summary: Approved several infrastructure requests, including the temporary removal of a High Street bus stop during construction, immediate LED lighting upgrades in city squares, and a building department review of sightline obstructions at the corner of Riverside and Park Street.
